name: Macaroni-Stuffed Zucchini Boats with Grape & Strawberry Fruit Salad

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap). Add salt, cover, and bring to a boil over high heat. Once boiling, uncover, add pasta, and stir for a few seconds; cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. Drain pasta and set aside. (Reserve pot for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
425 g macaroni (elbow) pasta

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
1 ½ (454 g) pkgs strawberries
0.45 kg red grapes

instructions.primary_message: Trim, and halve zucchini lengthwise. Scrape out the soft flesh from the middle of each half, place in a medium bowl, and set aside for later use.

Arrange zucchini halves, cut-side up, on a large baking sheet pan; drizzle with oil, then season with salt and pepper. Place in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake until softened, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: While the zucchini is baking, trim and quarter strawberries lengthwise. Place in a large bowl.
Halve grapes. Add to the bowl with the strawberries, stir to combine the fruit salad, and set aside.
When the pasta is done, return the pot to medium-high heat, add oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chopped zucchini and cook, stirring occasionally, until tender, 2-3 minutes.
Add flour to the pot and continue to cook, stirring constantly, until zucchini is well coated, about 1 minute.
Slowly pour milk into the pot, whisking constantly. Continue to cook, whisking constantly, until sauce has thickened, about 2 minutes.
Add cheese and spices to the pot. Continue whisking until cheese is melted and sauce is smooth, 1-2 minutes. Add cooked pasta, stir to combine, and remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
½ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: Divide zucchini boats between plates, then fill with macaroni and cheese. Serve with fruit salad on the side and enjoy!
